name: Anthropic API (Claude)
subtitle: Hosted AI models (Claude family)
creator: Anthropic
description: An API for Anthropic's Claude models, used for writing, analysis, coding, working with long documents and building agents that use tools. Also available through AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.

languages.youWrite: Official SDKs for Python and TypeScript, plus others

concepts.explanation: Send a conversation, get a reply.
Set the model's role and rules.
The model can request your functions.
How much text fits in one request.

codeSamples.label: Python
codeSamples.code:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()  # reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment

message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-sonnet-5-5",
    max_tokens=500,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize this order history in one sentence: ..."}],
)
print(message.content[0].text)

pros: Strong at long documents and coding
cons: Keys must stay on your server
